description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp\Promise\Create class which provides static methods for creating and handling promises, including creating fulfilled or rejected promises, wrapping values into promises, and generating iterators for values.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to create and manipulate promises and related objects in GuzzleHttp's promise library.

methods.name: promiseFor
methods.description: Creates a promise for a value if the value is not already a promise, handling objects with 'then' methods as thenables.

methods.name: rejectionFor
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise with a specified reason unless the reason is already a promise.

methods.name: exceptionFor
methods.description: Creates an exception object for a rejected promise value, converting non-throwable reasons into RejectionException.

methods.name: iterFor
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the given value, wrapping arrays and scalar values into ArrayIterator objects.
